title: Brazilian Leaf Wrap
description: A simple and delicious snack combining the flavors of Brazil with the freshness of leafy greens. Wrap all the ingredients in a soft wrap to create a perfect snack.

ingredients.name: Leafy Greens
ingredients.notes: any type of leafy green, chopped

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together Brazilian Doenjang and chopped leafy greens.
Lay a large jammy wrap on a clean surface.
Spread the doenjang and leaf mixture onto the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
